messages.text: I’m sorry, but refunds can only go to the order’s original payment—not another person’s account. Your sister’s consent doesn’t change that. If you accept a refund to the original payment, I can request BRL 149.65 for the speaker; the issuer handles any credit to an old or cancelled card, and the shop can’t promise where or when it appears (refund-policy/v2/payment; refund-policy/v2/amount). Would you like me to request it to the original payment?

messages.text: No, I don’t want a refund to the original payment. My sister has my permission to receive it in her account.

I understand, but the refund can’t be sent to your sister’s account. The policy allows a refund only to the order’s original payment, so I can’t request a different destination—even with your permission (refund-policy/v2/payment).
